newsitem.title: FRANCE: SocGen holding in PSA dips to 4.86 pct-CMF.
newsitem.headline: SocGen holding in PSA dips to 4.86 pct-CMF.

text.p: Societe Generale holds 4.86 percent of PSA Peugeot Citroen Peugeot Citroen voting rights after a sale of shares by its share trading business, the CMF markets regulator said on Wednesday.
The change in holding was notified under rules which require disclosure of stake sales when they push holdings above or below five percent of voting rights.
The CMF said in a statement Societe Generale held 3,173,711 voting rights, or 4.862 percent, out of the total voting rights in PSA.
Back in April, Societe Generale had disclosed ownership of 5.11 percent of PSA voting rights after a purchase of shares which pushed it above the five percent mark.
